delegation_ref.description: The delegation's own coordinate, delegation://{thread_id}/{subagent_id} — the actor coordinate the Subagent API section already names.

accountable_actor_ref.description: Who answers for the delegated work. Read by the platform for attribution, never for behaviour.

role_kind.description: OPAQUE TO THE PLATFORM. Closed here by contract so a nonsense value is refused at admission, while the daemon branches on no value: there is no match arm, no default and no behaviour keyed on it anywhere. What a reviewer DOES is the composing application's.

topology_kind.description: OPAQUE TO THE PLATFORM, on the same terms as role_kind. The retired GoalRun kernel emitted ONE hardcoded value and branched on it; a platform that enumerated ten and branched on them would be the same defect at a larger size.

ancestor_chain.description: Every ancestor whose bound this delegation narrows, nearest first. Its LENGTH is the delegation depth; depth is read off the chain rather than minted as a seventh reservation dimension.

delegation_depth.description: The admitted depth. Equal to the ancestor chain's length by invariant, never asserted independently of it.

depth_ceiling.description: The ceiling this delegation admitted under, narrowed from the parent's and never widened by a caller.

fanout_reservation_ref.description: The concurrent_invocations claim on the per-dimension reservation seam (R-74). Fanout is that claim, not a new mechanism.

forked_thread_ref.description: ADR 0031 primitive 1 of 5: the thread the fork planner minted.

harness_binding_ref.description: ADR 0031 primitive 5 of 5. Primitive 2, the fork itself, is the delegation this record IS.

orchestration_ref.description: The composing application's own scope, recorded verbatim and never resolved by the platform.

parent_thread_id.description: The delegating thread's id, bare, exactly as the thread plane mints it (thread_<suffix>). Bare because canon's delegation coordinate is delegation://{thread_id}/{subagent_id} and an edge that could not be composed from its own parts would be a second spelling.

child_subagent_id.description: The child object's id on the subagent surface. This edge NAMES the child and does not own it (ADR 0034 sub-ruling 5).
